name: Grouped Settings List
hint: Tap Notifications, then swipe from the left edge of the phone and hold mid-way: the whole push runs backwards under your finger. Press and hold a switch to see the knob stretch.
description: An app's Settings screen for React Native in the iOS 26 inset grouped style: a large title that collapses into the bar, live search, a profile card and groups with coloured icon squares, switches, value rows, a storage bar and a destructive Sign Out. Tapping a disclosure row pushes its page the UIKit way: the new page slides in over a soft edge shadow while the old one drifts a third of the way left and dims, the titles cross-fade and the old title slides into a glass back button. Swiping from the left edge drives that transition backwards with your finger, un-highlighting the row you came from in step, and the release projects your flick to complete or cancel. Switches stretch while held, spring across and can be dragged; checkmarks draw in; time rows open an inline drum picker; search filters every row on every page and highlights the match.
intents: ios settings screen with grouped list
react native settings page with toggles and disclosure rows
navigation push transition with swipe back gesture
inset grouped table view with switches and checkmarks
usage: Use for an app's own settings and preferences: a few short groups, one idea each, with the destructive action alone at the bottom. Put on/off choices on switches that apply at once, choices among options on checkmark pages, and anything with more than one control behind a disclosure row. Keep row titles short so search can find them, and always leave the back button alongside the swipe.
